rationale_short: Re-scope acc.2-acc.4 with verifier-owned replacement of execution evidence; read-only channel cannot produce exit codes/grep counts, so as written they certify confabulation. Moving execution facts to the independent verifier (stage 0.8) preserves distinguishability without weakening the control.
strongest_reasons: acc.2-acc.4 demand facts (exit 0, grep count) the read-only tool channel cannot produce, so they test confabulation, not task success; a gate passable only by fabrication is not a validity gate.
Test execution already belongs to the independent verifier (stage 0.8); re-homing execution evidence there keeps red/green distinguishability while agent checks stay read-establishable.
strongest_argument_against: A still needs a generation bump and risks the gate degrading to 'agent read some files'; only an execution-style check truly proves the work, which is what C offers.
cheapest_evidence_to_change_mind: Re-run the existing 48-turn read-only log through a candidate re-scoped fixture and confirm the positive control passes while neg-one, neg-marker, and neg-truncated each fail on distinct check ids; if distinguishability collapses, take B.

rejected.B: permanently-red gate fires the stage-0.1 stop condition and voids every arm; avoidable if A preserves distinguishability
rejected.C: exec inside a grader of agent behaviour on a shared live server breaks no_write constraints and sets an unbounded precedent
rejected.D: not needed; verifier-owned replacement is within A's 'or are replaced' clause
